entries.source: Structures maps show recorded shade cloth over the illustrated beds.

drafts.zu: Amamephu eStructures abonisa indwangu yomthunzi erekhodiwe phezu kwemibhede edwetshiwe.
drafts.st: Dimmapa tsa Structures di bontsha lesela la moriti le rekotilweng hodima dibethe tse takilweng.
drafts.ts: Mimepe ya Structures yi komba lapi ra ndzhuti leri rhekhodiweke ehenhla ka mibedo leyi dirowiweke.
drafts.ve: Mapa a Structures a sumbedza laphu ḽa murunzi ḽo rekhodiwaho nṱha ha mibhedzi yo olwaho.

entries.source: Open Structures, then reassemble the saved AI artwork to show its shade cover.

drafts.zu: Vula iStructures, bese uhlanganisa futhi umdwebo we-AI ogciniwe ukuze ubonise isembozo somthunzi.
drafts.st: Bula Structures, ebe o kopanya botjha setshwantsho sa AI se bolokilweng ho bontsha sekoahelo sa moriti.
drafts.ts: Pfula Structures, kutani u tlhela u hlanganisa xifaniso xa AI lexi hlayisiweke ku komba xifunengeto xa ndzhuti.
drafts.ve: Vulani Structures, ni kone u dovha na kuvhanganya tshifanyiso tsha AI tsho vhulungwaho uri tshi sumbedze tshitsireledzi tsha murunzi.
